title: An Introduction to Meshtastic
summary: Meshtastic is a mesh networking protocol that enables long-range, low-power communication using LoRa radios without requiring internet or cellular connectivity, making it ideal for off-grid scenarios, emergency situations, and outdoor adventures.
problem_solved: Provides reliable off-grid communication when traditional internet and cellular infrastructure is unavailable or destroyed.
why_valuable: Enables community-driven, decentralized communication networks that work independently of existing infrastructure for emergency preparedness and remote connectivity.
